nodes.label: Caregiver

properties.title: Caregiver
properties.description: Mother, father, guardian, carer of the child, infant, elderly or disabled person.

nodes.label: Health worker (HW)

properties.title: Health worker (HW)

nodes.label: IMMZ.C Client registration

properties.description: Client registration
properties.objectives: Create and/or update the clients’ vaccine record by including personal data in the EIR to support future vaccine administration

nodes.label: IMMZ.D Administer vaccine

properties.description: Administer vaccine
properties.objectives: To determine which vaccines a client needs, administer those and record the relevant necessary data both in the EIR as well as in the appropriate paper records
